name: Expiry report: expired batches or batches expiring within N days.
description: Expiry report: expired batches or batches expiring within N days. Part of the Reports APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

Auth-Key.description: Company auth key. Send this or Session-Id. One is required.

Session-Id.description: Logged-in user session. Send this or Auth-Key. One is required.

withinDays.description: Within days query parameter. Default: 30. Optional.

expiredOnly.description: Expired only query parameter. Default: false. Optional.
